Always follow this order before writing or changing any css code:

1. Read the css_requirements.md file in the ui_reference folder, and make sure all rules are followed
2. read the css_variables_usage.md file in the ui_reference directory and apply the patterns discussed there before attempting to write custom css
3. only use variables that in the variables.css file for css styling, except for things that cannot be otherwise done or do not have a variable. That being said, if something doesnt have a variable, and you needed custom css that isnt otherwise widely used in the project, I want you to explicitly tell me in the summary after you complete the task.
4. any custom, or non standard css must be commented within the code.
